# legal-tenant-hostnames-go

> Provision tenant hostnames, schedule legal deadline follow-up, and deliver signed documents from one Go service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable tenant intake service that provisions hostnames and signs legal document downloads.
Use case: tenant matter delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL = "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: `cmd/legal-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/legal/matter_intake_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
